claim: Patchline ships a standards-body-ratified certificate format with conformance tests and reference implementations. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the conformance tests claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make ratified-certificate-format-gate`.
